description: Ranked source domains that AI answer engines cite for one category and question shape, with citation rate (share of monitored answer runs citing the domain), rank, percentile and source role (editorial publication, vendor-owned, analyst research, community, academic/government, market database, wire distribution). Use to answer 'which publications/sources does ChatGPT or Perplexity cite for <category>' or 'where should a <category> brand earn coverage to be cited by AI'.

question_shape.description: Buyer question pattern: best_x (best X tools), how_choose (how to choose), is_x_worth (is it worth it), news_topic (recent news), problem_first (how to solve a problem), top_list (top platforms), x_vs_y (A vs B).

source_role.description: Optional filter, e.g. editorial_media for publications only, vendor_owned, analyst_research, community_social.

name: mri_get_cited_sources
title: Which sources AI engines cite
